videos.title: Silicon Valley's "last train" mindset
videos.description:
"Right now, Silicon Valley is uncharacteristically full of people who don't actually love computers."

Max Schoening (Head of Product at Notion) on why the fear of missing the last train is a bad reason to build anything.

videos.title: What Great Product Design Looks Like
videos.description:
There's no training data for the next great product idea.

Ian Silber (Head of Design at OpenAI) on why human designers still have the edge over AI.

videos.title: The One Trait that Matters Most in the AI Age
videos.description:
"I don't think agency is very evenly distributed in the world."

Max Schoening (Head of Product at Notion) on why agency, not skill, decides who does well from here.

videos.title: Why This is the Best Time to be a Designer
videos.description:
Some founders are now hiring two designers for every one engineer.

Ian Silber (Head of Design at OpenAI) on why that ratio is starting to flip.

videos.title: "Nobody should feel behind right now"
videos.description: Ian Silber (Head of Product Design at OpenAI) explains how, if you're using AI already, you're earlier than you think.

videos.title: What's Driving ChatGPT's UI Changes
videos.description:
Instead of making you type everything out, ChatGPT now just asks.

videos.title: 8 people left OpenAI to start Anthropic
videos.description:
Anthropic co-founder on leaving OpenAI: "Safety wasn't the top priority there."

Benjamin Mann on why he wanted a lab that could push the frontier and still put safety first.

videos.description:
Is anyone's job actually safe from AI? Anthropic's own co-founder doesn't think so.
